(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

 \(\frac{h_{X}}{h_{X}+h_{Y}}=\sqrt{\frac{1}{1+8}}=\frac{1}{3}\) {*}{\(\left\{1 \mathrm{M} \\ +1 \mathrm{~A}\right.\)}

 \(\frac{V_{X}}{V_{X}+V_{X}+8000 \pi}=\frac{1}{27}\) 1 M

 ∴ The volume of \(X\) is \(320 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 
 (b) Volume of \(W\) 
 \(=320 \pi \times 27=8640 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Height of \(W\) 
 \(=15 \times 3=45 \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(W\) 
 \(\frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2} \times 45=8640 \pi\) for volume of cone 
 \(r=24\)

 \(\frac{1}{3} \pi r_{w}{ }^{2} \times 15=320 \pi\) 1 M for volume of cone 
 \(r_{w}=8\) 
 \(r=3 \times 8=24\) 
 Total surface area of \(W\) 
 \(=\pi \times 24 \times \sqrt{24^{2}+45^{2}}+\pi \times 24^{2}\) for \(\pi r l\) 
 \(=1800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 Surface area of sphere 
 \(=4 \pi \times 21^{2}\) 1 M for \(4 \pi r^{2}\) 
 \(=1764 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 \(<1800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\)

questions.stem: 14. A right circular cone is cut into three parts by two planes parallel to its base. The base radius and the height of the upper part of the cone are 6 cm and 20 cm respectively. (a) Find the volume of the upper part of the cone in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks) (b) If the height of the middle part is 10 cm, find the volume of the middle part. (3 marks) (c) The height of the lower part is 10 cm. Amy claims that the curved surface area of the lower part is more than \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分。圓錐上部的底半徑及高分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(20\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐上部的體積。（2 分）

(b) 若中間部分的高為 \(10\) cm，求中間部分的體積。（3 分）

(c) 下部的高為 \(10\) cm。Amy 聲稱下部的曲面面積多於 \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the upper cone is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(20)=240\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (2 marks) (b) Since the planes are parallel to the base, the cones are similar. The upper cone has height 20 cm and radius 6 cm. For the cone formed by the upper and middle parts, its height is \[20+10=30\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its radius is \[6\cdot\frac{30}{20}=9\text{ cm}.\] Hence the volume of the cone formed by the upper and middle parts is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(9)^2(30)=810\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of the middle part is \[810\pi-240\pi=570\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (c) The whole cone has height \[20+10+10=40\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its base radius is \[6\cdot\frac{40}{20}=12\text{ cm}.\] The radius at the top of the lower part is \(9\) cm, and the radius at the bottom of the lower part is \(12\) cm. The height of the lower part is \(10\) cm, so its slant height is \[\sqrt{10^2+(12-9)^2}=\sqrt{109}\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the lower frustum is \[\pi(9+12)\sqrt{109}=21\sqrt{109}\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[21\sqrt{109}>200,\] the curved surface area is more than \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Therefore, I agree with Amy's claim. (4 marks)

14. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 20 cm and 48 cm respectively. The cone is divided into a cone \(X\), a middle frustum \(Y\) and a bottom frustum \(Z\) by two planes which are parallel to its base. It is given that \(Y\) and \(Z\) are similar, and the height of \(Z\) is 12 cm.

(a) Express the volume of \(Z\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Another different solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(S\) and a cone \(T\) by a plane parallel to its base. The height of \(S\) is 16 cm. The total surface area of \(S\) is equal to the sum of the total surface areas of \(Y\) and \(Z\). Is \(Z\) similar to \(S\)? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(48\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\)、一個中截頭 \(Y\) 及一個下截頭 \(Z\)。已知 \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 相似，且 \(Z\) 的高為 \(12\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Z\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(S\) 及一個圓錐 \(T\)。\(S\) 的高為 \(16\) cm，\(S\) 的總表面積等於 \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的總表面積之和。\(Z\) 與 \(S\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) For the bottom frustum \(Z\), the lower radius is 20 cm and the height is 12 cm. Its upper plane is at a distance \[48-12=36\text{ cm}\] from the vertex of the original cone. By similarity of cones, the upper radius of \(Z\) is \[20\left(\frac{36}{48}\right)=15\text{ cm}.\] The volume of \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(12)(20^2+20\cdot 15+15^2)\] \[=4\pi(400+300+225) =3700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{12^2+(20-15)^2}=13.\] The total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2\] \[=455\pi+400\pi+225\pi =1080\pi.\] Since \(Y\) and \(Z\) are similar, and the lower radius of \(Y\) is the upper radius of \(Z\), the linear scale factor from \(Z\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{15}{20}=\frac34.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(Y\) is \[1080\pi\left(\frac34\right)^2=607.5\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(S\) is \[1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] Now \[\frac{\text{TSA of }S}{\text{TSA of }Z} =\frac{1687.5\pi}{1080\pi} =\frac{25}{16},\] but \[\left(\frac{\text{height of }S}{\text{height of }Z}\right)^2 =\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2 =\frac{16}{9}.\] Since \[\frac{25}{16}\ne\frac{16}{9},\] \(Z\) and \(S\) are not similar. (4 marks)

(c) 若再將一個半徑 \(4\) cm 的實心金屬球放入圓錐容器，球完全浸入水中，水會否溢出？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）

top part is the frustum Z. The ratio of the height of X to that of Y to that of Z is 3 : 2 : 1.

(b) It is given that the height and the base radius of the original cone are 24 cm and 18 cm

(ii) Find the curved surface area of Y in terms of π.

questions.stemZh:
12. 一個倒置直立圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分：底部為圓錐 \(X\)，中部為截頭錐 \(Y\)，頂部為截頭錐 \(Z\)。\(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\) 的高之比為 \(3:2:1\)。

(a) 求 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\) 的體積比。（2 分）

(b) 已知原圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Z\) 的體積。
(ii) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。（5 分）

截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
questions.solution:

12. A solid metal right prism of base area \(84\text{ cm}^2\) and height \(20\) cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right pyramids. The bases of the two pyramids are squares. The ratio of the base area of the smaller pyramid to the base area of the larger pyramid is \(4:9\).

(a) Find the volume of the larger pyramid.

(b) If the height of the larger pyramid is \(12\) cm, find the total surface area of the smaller pyramid.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個底面積 \(84\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(20\) cm 的實心直立棱柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立錐體，兩錐底面均為正方形。較小錐與較大錐的底面積比為 \(4:9\)。

(a) 求較大錐的體積。

(b) 若較大錐的高為 \(12\) cm，求較小錐的總表面積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
柱體：體積 = 底面積 × 高。
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: The total volume of metal is \(84(20)=1680\text{ cm}^3.\) The ratio of corresponding lengths of the smaller pyramid to the larger pyramid is \(\sqrt{4:9}=2:3.\) Hence the ratio of their volumes is \(8:27.\) (a) The volume of the larger pyramid is \[1680\left(\frac{27}{8+27}\right)=1296\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[1680-1296=384\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac23(12)=8\text{ cm}.\] Let the side length of its square base be \(s\). Then \[\frac13s^2(8)=384\] so \[s^2=144,\qquad s=12.\] The slant height of each triangular face is \[\sqrt{8^2+6^2}=10.\] Thus the total surface area is \[144+4\left(\frac12(12)(10)\right)=384\text{ cm}^2.\] Final answers: (a) \(1296\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(384\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of the smaller sphere.

(b) The two spheres are melted and recast into two solid right circular cones. Denote these two circular cones by \(A\) and \(B\). It is given that the height and the base radius of \(A\) are \(10\text{ cm}\) and \(6\text{ cm}\) respectively. A student finds that the base radius of \(B\) is \(12\text{ cm}\). The student claims that \(A\) and \(B\) are similar. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的表面積比為 \(4:9\)，較大球半徑為 \(9\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小球的體積。

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立圓錐，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。已知 \(A\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(6\) cm，某學生量得 \(B\) 的底半徑為 \(12\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 相似。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) Since the surface area ratio is \(4:9\), the radius ratio is \(2:3\), and the volume ratio is \(8:27\). Therefore \[V_{\text{smaller}}=\frac{8}{27}\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of \(A\) is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(10)=120\pi.\] The volume of \(B\) is \[288\pi+\frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3-120\pi=1140\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{V_B}{V_A}=\frac{1140\pi}{120\pi}=\frac{19}{2}.\] If \(A\) and \(B\) were similar, the volume ratio should be \[\left(\frac{12}{6}\right)^3=8.\] Since \(8\ne \frac{19}{2}\), \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. Final answers: (a) \(288\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) no.

14. The base radius and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are \(14\text{ cm}\) and \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times the curved surface area of \(X\).

(i) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) If \(Y\) is melted and recast into 2 identical solid spheres, find the diameter of each sphere.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的底半徑及曲面面積分別為 \(14\) cm 及 \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(Y\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的 \(15\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。
(ii) 若將 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相同的實心球，求每個球的直徑。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(l\) be the slant height of the circular cone. Since the curved surface area is \(700\pi\), \[\pi(14)l=700\pi.\] Thus \[ l=50. \] The height is \[\sqrt{50^2-14^2}=48\text{ cm}.\] (b)(i) Since the curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times that of \(X\), the whole cone has curved surface area \(16\) times that of \(X\). Therefore the linear scale factor from \(X\) to the whole cone is \(1:4\), and the volume of \(X\) is \(\frac{1}{64}\) of the volume of the whole cone. The volume of the whole cone is \(\frac{1}{3}\pi(14)^2(48)=3136\pi.\) Hence \(V_Y=3136\pi\left(1-\frac{1}{64}\right)=3087\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b)(ii) If the diameter of each sphere is \(d\), then \(2\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi\left(\frac{d}{2}\right)^3=3087\pi.\) Solving gives \(d=21.\) Final answers: (a) \(48\text{ cm}\); (b)(i) \(3087\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b)(ii) \(21\text{ cm}\).

(a) Express the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Express the total surface area of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) \(X\) is melted and recast into a solid cube. Does the total surface area of the cube exceed the total surface area of \(X\)? Explain your answer.

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的總表面積。

(c) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心立方體。立方體的總表面積是否超過 \(X\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。

questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。

questions.solution: (a) The height of the small cone is \[45-30=15\text{ cm}.\] The small cone is similar to the original cone with linear scale factor \[\frac{15}{45}=\frac13.\] Therefore the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\left(\frac13\right)^3\right) =8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=51\text{ cm}.\] The radius and slant height of the small cone are respectively \[8\text{ cm} \text{and} 17\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17).\] The two circular faces have total area \[\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2.\] Hence the total surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17)+\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2 =1728\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (c) Let the side length of the cube be \(x\) cm. Since the volume is unchanged, \[x^3=8320\pi.\] Thus \[x\approx 29.6773.\] The total surface area of the cube is \[6x^2\approx 5284.45\text{ cm}^2.\] Also, \[1728\pi\approx 5428.67\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[5284.45<5428.67,\] the total surface area of the cube does not exceed the total surface area of \(X\). Final answers: (a) \(8320\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\); (c) no.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）小錐高 15，線性比 1/3：
\[
V_X=\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\frac1{27}\right)=8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]

\(r_1:r_2:r_3=2:3:5.\)

(a) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A craftsman finds that the height of \(Y\) is 9 cm.

(i) Find \(r_2\).
(ii) The craftsman claims that the total surface area of \(Z\) is greater than the surface area of the sphere. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

(b) 某工匠量得 \(Y\) 的高為 \(9\) cm。

(ii) 該工匠聲稱 \(Z\) 的總表面積大於球的表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

questions.hintZh:

Then \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(3k)^2(4k)=324\pi.\] Thus \(12k^3=324,\qquad k^3=27,\qquad k=3.\) The base radius and height of \(Y\) are 9 cm and 12 cm respectively. The slant height of \(Y\) is \(\sqrt{9^2+12^2}=15.\) Therefore the curved surface area of \(Y\) is \(\pi(9)(15)=135\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (c) Since the curved surface area ratio of two similar cones equals the square of their corresponding length ratio, \[\frac{\text{curved surface area of }X}{\text{curved surface area of }Y}=\frac{4}{9}.\] Thus \(\text{curved surface area of }X=135\pi\times\frac{4}{9}=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) Since the height ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(2:3\), the height of \(X\) is \(12\times\frac{2}{3}=8\text{ cm}.\) Hence the height of \(Z\) is also 8 cm. The small cone removed from \(Y\) has height \(12-8=4\) cm, so its linear scale compared with \(Y\) is \(\frac{4}{12}=\frac{1}{3}\). Therefore \(\text{curved surface area of }Z =135\pi-135\pi\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2 =120\pi.\) Since \(120\pi=2(60\pi),\) the claim is correct. (8 marks)

(a) 求其體積。

questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。

questions.solution: 14. Let the removed cone height be \(h\). Then \(\frac{h}{h+8}=\frac9{15}\), so \(h=12\). The volume is \(\frac13\pi(15)^2(20)-\frac13\pi(9)^2(12)=1176\pi\). The slant height of \(X\) is \(10\), so the linear scale factor to \(Y\) is \(12/10\). Thus \(V_Y=1176\pi(1.2)^3=2032.128\pi\approx6384>6000\), so the claim is not correct. For the sphere, \(\frac43\pi r^3=2032.128\pi\), giving \(r\approx11.5\) cm.
